QuestInfo.name: Elma's New Look 1
QuestInfo.0: #bElma the Housekeeper#k in #bOrbis Park#k has something to tell you.
QuestInfo.1: Elma the Housekeeper is sick of keeping an empty house, and wants to pretty herself up. Get an accessory for her.\n\n#i1132074##t1132074#  #b#c1132074# / 1#k

0.0: Hmph... The master isn't coming home anytime soon, and I'm not even getting paid. But i can't leave because of my contract. Am I doomed to waste my youth here?
0.1: I want to gussy myself up and go out on the town! But when a housekeeper dresses up, her master scolds her. Then again, my master isn't here...

yes.0: I hear more and more people are getting into Accessory Crafting. Could you bring me a belt crafted by a Jeweler?
yes.1: This #bLucky Green Leather Belt#k makes me feel so...well, lucky!

1.0: Oh, is that the belt? Let me try it on!

yes.0: Hm... Does this dress go with this belt? Maybe I need another dress? Oh, how fun!

item.0: Hmm... I think a #bLucky Green Leather Belt#k would be splendid. If only you were a Jeweler...
